name: @monoes/monomindcli
description: CLI engine for Monomind — an open-source MCP server that extends Claude Code with a codebase knowledge graph (tree-sitter + SQLite), persistent memory, multi-agent task coordination, and session hooks. Apache 2.0 licensed, fully local.

scripts.build: tsc && node ../../../scripts/build-fs.mjs copy-into dist/src/browser/dashboard src/browser/dashboard/ui.html && node ../../../scripts/build-fs.mjs copy-into dist/src/ui src/ui/dashboard.html src/ui/server.mjs src/ui/collector.mjs src/ui/orgs.html src/ui/orgs-files.js src/ui/sse-manager.mjs src/ui/routes-monograph.mjs src/ui/routes-org.mjs src/ui/mastermind-diagram-fallback.html && node ../../../scripts/build-fs.mjs clean dist/src/ui/data && node ../../../scripts/build-fs.mjs copy-dir src/ui/data dist/src/ui/data
scripts.build:loose: tsc --noEmitOnError false || true && node ../../../scripts/build-fs.mjs copy-into dist/src/browser/dashboard src/browser/dashboard/ui.html && node ../../../scripts/build-fs.mjs copy-into dist/src/ui src/ui/dashboard.html src/ui/server.mjs src/ui/collector.mjs src/ui/orgs.html src/ui/orgs-files.js src/ui/sse-manager.mjs src/ui/routes-monograph.mjs src/ui/routes-org.mjs src/ui/mastermind-diagram-fallback.html && node ../../../scripts/build-fs.mjs clean dist/src/ui/data && node ../../../scripts/build-fs.mjs copy-dir src/ui/data dist/src/ui/data
scripts.prepublishOnly: node ../../@monoes/monodesign/scripts/sync-skill.mjs && node ../../../scripts/build-fs.mjs copy-into . ../../../README.md && npm run build
scripts.release: npm version prerelease --preid=alpha && npm run publish:all
